practice_quiz.question: Assessment Question 1: Which statement correctly evaluates CPU Hardware and RAM ROM Memory (Unit 8)?
practice_quiz.question_amharic: የምዘና ጥያቄ 1፡ ስለ ሲፒዩ (CPU)፣ ራም (RAM) እና ሮም (ROM) ሜሞሪ (ምዕራፍ 8) ትክክለኛውን መግለጫ የትኛው ነው?
